title: GLG Expands to 96K SF at One Grand Central Place, Adding Full Second Floor
summary: GLG expanded its global headquarters at One Grand Central Place by 18,230 SF to a total of 95,612 SF across two full floors, following an April 2025 lease renewal of 77,382 SF. The expansion signals continued confidence in the expert network's NYC hub.
whyItMatters: Office expansion indicates continued headcount growth at the industry's largest player.
